questions.question_text: What is a key feature of Google Classroom that helps high school students stay organized, as described in the chapter?

options.text: It automatically completes assignments for you
It provides a “To-Do” list to track upcoming and overdue tasks across classes
It blocks distracting websites during class time
It offers premium games for study breaksCorrect Answer: B) It provides a “To-Do” list to track upcoming and overdue tasks across classes

questions.question_text: According to the chapter, how can Google Calendar help students balance school and extracurricular activities?

options.text: It writes essays and creates study guides automatically
It allows color-coding of events and setting reminders for deadlines and practices
It limits screen time by shutting down apps after a set period
It connects directly to social media for quick updatesCorrect Answer: B) It allows color-coding of events and setting reminders for deadlines and practices

questions.question_text: Which feature of Microsoft OneNote makes it particularly useful for note-taking during high school classes, based on the chapter?

options.text: It provides pre-made flashcards for every subject
It lets you search keywords across all notebooks for quick test prep
It restricts access to notes to prevent sharing with classmates
It only works offline to avoid distractionsCorrect Answer: B) It lets you search keywords across all notebooks for quick test prep

questions.question_text: What is a primary advantage of using Google Docs for group projects, as highlighted in the chapter?

options.text: It blocks teammates from editing to maintain control
It allows real-time collaboration and commenting to assign tasks and edit together
It automatically grades the project for submission
It works only on desktop computers for securityCorrect Answer: B) It allows real-time collaboration and commenting to assign tasks and edit together

questions.question_text: What is one strategy from the chapter to avoid digital distractions during study time?

options.text: Keep all notifications on to stay updated with friends
Use the Pomodoro Technique with 25-minute study blocks followed by short breaks
Study while watching videos to stay entertained
Keep your phone visible to answer urgent calls instantlyCorrect Answer: B) Use the Pomodoro Technique with 25-minute study blocks followed by short breaks

questions.question_text: How canPadletbeused effectively for group projects, according to the chapter?

options.text: It creates automatic citations for research sources
It serves as a virtual bulletin board for brainstorming and sharing ideas, links, or images
It limits group access to one user at a time for clarity
It schedules study sessions without input from team membersCorrect Answer: B) It serves as a virtual bulletin board for brainstorming and sharing ideas, links, or images
